title: Trevor Story hits a bases-loaded RBI single in 10th to lift Red Sox to 9-8 win over Mariners
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Boston Red Sox Jarren Duran hit a two-run homer and Mickey Gasper a solo shot for the Red Sox, who were coming off a rough weekend when they dropped three of four to the Yankees.
Trevor Story of the Red Sox flips his bat after hitting a game-winning RBI single in the bottom of the 10th.

AP Photo/Charles Krupa BOSTON (AP) — Trevor Story drove in the winning run with a bases-loaded single in the 10th inning after Seattle walked the two batters before him intentionally, lifting the Boston Red Sox to a 9-8 comeback victory over the Seattle Mariners on Monday night.
